name: Tokimeke Hamster!!
source:
Your life in "Hidamari Village" suddenly begins!
Interact with the residents at your own pace and aim for a happy ending.
What happens if you mess up...?
Nothing but hamsters appear!
A laid-back horror (?) hamster otome game!

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/tokiham.html]official website[/url]]
